scope: Independent static Eq23-form isolation with current Wendland and h/dp=1.8 only. No production, original test, formal input or retained output modification. No solver/native/build/time integration/plots. Root must read the complete evaluator and this note before actual offline execution admission.

equations.coordinates: r=xj-xi=-CSV_d; g=kernel_fac_float*CSV_d=grad_iW. 2D axes are x,z with V=dp^2 and a 2x2 C; 3D uses xyz and V=dp^3.
equations.G1: b_j=Vj*Ci*g_j; G=sum b_j*(fj-fi); M=sum b_j*r_j^T. 2D Ci/Cj are recomputed locally; full21 stored receiver C is an independent descriptive comparison.
equations.tensor: D_mn=(dimension+2)*r_m*r_n/r2-delta_mn; F=r.dot(Cs*g)/(r2+eta); s_mn=V*D_mn*F; T_mn=sum s_mn*r; rawH=sum s_mn*df; defect=G.dot(T_mn); H=rawH-defect. D's directional denominator remains r2 even with Eta2.
equations.variants: Ci/Eta0; real Cavg/Eta0; real Cavg/Eta2. G always uses Ci. Only the 2D Ci/Eta0 variant is the literal Eq23 algebraic form, with Wendland substituted for the paper's chosen kernel. Cavg/Eta variants are explicit modified comparisons. 3D D5 is a conditional dimension generalization, not a literal paper 3D reproduction.
equations.scalar: Independently construct w=2V*d.dot(Cs*g)/(r2+eta), lx=sum w*d, scalar=-sum w*df-G.dot(lx). trace(D)=2 gives trace(H)=scalar, subject to arithmetic residuals.
equations.coefficients: h_j^mn=s_j^mn-b_j.dot(T_mn). Record first moment sum h_j*r_j. P1 follows only if M=I: first=(I-M^T)*T. No P2 exactness is assumed.
equations.basis: Rows/columns xx,zz,xz in 2D or xx,yy,zz,xy,xz,yz in 3D; basis functions r_a^2/2 on diagonal and r_a*r_b off diagonal. Response diagonal columns=sum h*r_a^2/2 and off-diagonal columns=sum h*r_a*r_b. No engineering-shear factor2. Report response-I without an accuracy pass gate.

clouds.2D_full21: Read only nodes_regular_21.csv and nodes_disorder_21.csv from sealed P1 r1c. Three reference-grid receivers (10,10),(0,10),(10,0); ghost9 gives complete local C neighborhoods. dp=1/20, h=1.8dp. Reference-index reach4 and cached local C/edges only; no all-pairs global matrix.
clouds.2D_truncated9: Read only matrix_nodes_regular.csv and matrix_nodes_disorder.csv. Three receivers (4,4),(0,4),(0,0); dp=1/8, h=1.8dp. This is a geometrically truncated patch, not a wall/drainage boundary model. C is recomputed because these CSVs do not contain C.
clouds.3D: Read the old 12 receiver instances from four scalar3d clouds. Use saved Ci/Cavg, rr2 and actual float fac; no kernel recomputation or new cloud. Reconstruct xj=xi-d only for manufactured field evaluation.
clouds.coverage: 24 receiver instances * 3 variants =72 tensor_moments rows; 12 2D receivers*3*10 fields +12 3D receivers*3*14 fields =864 tensor_fields rows. Small local rows only, no global operator/spectrum/flux calculation.

fields: 2D uses the old P1 10 field definitions including sine and hydrostatic_head; 3D uses the old scalar3d 14 definitions including smooth_cos_xyz. Analytic gradients and full Hessians are calculated independently. Polynomial evaluation uses algebraic coefficient/Hessian form and math.fsum; it does not claim bitwise reproduction of the old C++ field-expression order.

precision.kernel2d: Python struct float32 round-trips explicitly model archived bwen/rad/qq/wqq1 and chained float Fac operations; coordinates/moments/C remain binary64, reductions use math.fsum. This is a reference formula emulation, not proof of native CRT sqrt, compiler evaluation/FMA, or old C bitwise identity. Full21 recomputed-minus-stored C is descriptive, never an accepted native regression gate.
precision.Eta2: 3D reads current_Eta2_float from sealed completion. 2D uses float32((0.1*h)^2), explicitly differing from old P1's binary64 .01*h*h regularization; old P1 scalar samples are not presented as exact comparisons.
precision.reconstruction: 3D xj=xi-d may differ by 1ulp from the original cloud coordinate; old field-expression order also differs. trace-minus-old-Lstar is descriptive roundoff/reconstruction residual, not a bitwise replay claim or an accuracy gate.
precision.storage: Manufactured fields and local operator arithmetic are binary64, not native float pressure or a complete production rate/force call.

roundoff_model.formula: epsilon=sys.float_info.epsilon; gamma=(64*N+256)*epsilon/(1-(64*N+256)*epsilon); bound=gamma*max(1,scale). Fixed conservative operation-count model, not a formal IEEE/native-compiler forward-error proof.
roundoff_model.field_scale: max(abs(fi),max abs(fj)); scale=max(abs(independent_scalar),sum abs(H),max_mn sum abs(s_mn*df),max_mn(sum abs(h_mn)*field_scale)). Same fixed bound checks trace-scalar, coefficient-action-H and constant/affine corrected H. No adjustment after results.
roundoff_model.limits: These are newly declared arithmetic consistency checks, not changed physical or old-test gates. Quadratic/smooth Hessian errors, basis-I, P1 first moments, stored-C and old-Lstar differences are fully reported without fitted acceptance thresholds. Failure remains visible and raises after fresh output retention.
